description: Composition policy for scatter/distribution patterns — vegetation scatter, debris/rubble, urban prop scatter, surface_scatter operations. Pattern: host surface or volume (primary_volume tagged 'host_surface') + instance pool (asset references) + per-instance placement rules (density, jitter, slope/curvature filters, scale/rotation variation) + optional collision avoidance. Expansions add a scatter_instance node when the brief declares density/instance_pool and add a collision_filter node when collision_avoidance is set. Useful for any family whose recipe emits sop.copy_to_points or sop.scatter_on_surface — and per the migration inventory that is most of the 71 _RECIPES families.
